editorial:
Ever wondered how you actually film a movie where snakes are everywhere? You get to step behind the curtain with director Katy Leigh to see how the chaos of Snakes on a Plane came together. It is a lighthearted look at the cast and crew, where you see Samuel L. Jackson and other stars talking about their real-life fears. The vibe is very relaxed and funny, making you feel like you are just hanging out on set while the crew explains the madness of working with hundreds of reptiles in a fake airplane cabin.

What really makes this stand out is seeing the contrast between the scary scenes in the movie and the actual goofiness of the production. You will love seeing the fake snake tricks and hearing the actors admit how creeped out they were. While it is a short featurette, it moves quickly and never feels boring. If you are a fan of movie magic, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection or look for it as a bonus feature when renting on Apple TV for a crisp, clear picture.
endingExplained: The documentary wraps up by showing the final result of all that hard work. It ends with a montage of the best action shots from the movie and final thoughts from the crew. They explain how they managed to keep the animals safe while making the scenes look terrifying. It concludes with the cast laughing about the experience, leaving you with a clear view of how much fun they had making such a wild movie.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves movie trivia and creature features.
